t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Fight or Flight
d: While on a routine sightseeing flight, a massive storm has the pilots fighting to keep their passengers safe.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Heaven at 5,000 Feet
d: Pilot Josiah Freeman takes a professional snowboarder Mark Barajas to the top of the Chugach Mountains for some hellacious heli-skiing.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Deadman's Survival
d: Island Air battles time and the elements, to rescue a group trapped in Deadman's Bay.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Into The Deep
d: The bush pilots have to use all their skills - scuba diving, underwater rigging and expert flying - to try and salvage a de Havilland Beaver wing at the bottom of the 6 Mile Lake.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Desperate Times
d: Island Air drops off a group of desperate hunters in the heart of the bush as a deep freeze hits Kodiak.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | On Thin Ice
d: On a rare day off, Josiah and his friends white water raft where few have gone before - on top of the massive Knik Glacier.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Risky Business
d: Pilot Peter Rosendahl combats gail force wind and choppy seas while taxiing a group of hunters to a floating lodge.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Ice Climbers
d: Tanalian Aviation battles winter weather to ferry ice climbers onto the Knik Glacier.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Training Day
d: New pilots are put to the test to see if they have what it takes to fly for Island Air.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Salvage Gone Awry
d: Joel and Mark Barker tempt fate and fly into no man's land to find and salvage a white airplane in a snowy forest, and fight hypothermia along the way.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Surf's Up
d: Rough seas have a couple of surfers turning to Island Air for an adventure of a life time.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Hanging by a Thread
d: Tanalian Aviation bush pilots Joel and Josiah earn their keep slinging a stranded snow machine.

t: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots | Closing Time
d: An unexpected storm leaves Island Air struggling to pull their planes for mandatory maintenance.
